name: sunny-coastal-youth-documentary
image_vibe: Joyful candid shoreline, warm natural daylight, authentic travel documentary
image_purpose: Create a two-moment coastal group scene for travel lifestyle storytelling.

prompt.project_info: A realistic candid beach photography sequence of six adult friends on a sunny shoreline.
prompt.main_subject: Six original adults—two athletic men and four women—wearing appropriate swim shorts and secure swimwear, barefoot on the sand, laughing and playfully pouring sand between their hands. No individual face is emphasized.
prompt.composition_elements: Two related documentary moments: first the group plays with sand near the water; second they relax and pose together holding plastic cups, with one woman seated on a white plastic chair and others standing around her. Include local food stalls, plastic chairs, umbrellas, simple concrete buildings, ocean waves, and clear sky.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm natural daylight, soft shadows, natural skin tones, handheld-camera feel, realistic beach textures, and carefree joyful travel mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic documentary photography, natural perspective, high detail, candid group composition, coherent continuity between two moments, no heavy retouching, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a realistic candid beach-photography sequence of six original adults on a sunny shoreline: two athletic men and four women in secure swimwear and swim shorts, barefoot on the sand, laughing and playfully pouring sand between their hands. Show a lively coastal setting with small local food stalls, plastic chairs, umbrellas, simple concrete buildings, ocean waves, and clear blue sky. In the second related moment, show the group relaxed and posing together with plastic cups of drinks, one woman seated on a white plastic chair while others stand around her. Use warm natural daylight, soft shadows, natural skin tones, handheld documentary feel, realistic lighting, and carefree travel-lifestyle mood.
